girona.note: 150km marquee loop linking Els Àngels, Sant Hilari and the Rocacorba climb — the big day the pros train on.

mallorca.note: 155km Serra de Tramuntana epic in the spirit of the Mallorca 312, Sa Calobra and all.

bright.note: 150km high-country queen stage over Mt Buffalo and Tawonga Gap — Alpine Classic territory.

adelaide-hills.note: 140km loop over Norton Summit, the Corkscrew and Gorge Rd — a proper hills century.

beechworth.note: 145km loop out to the alpine foothills and back through the historic gold country.

noosa.note: 135km loop deep into the hinterland — Black Mountain, Pomona and the Range.

derby.note: 130km backcountry gravel and singletrack epic linking the Blue Derby network.

bentonville.note: 145km Ozark gravel and greenway epic across the OZ Trails network.

hualien.note: 150km coast-to-gorge epic climbing the Taroko pass — a serious big day.

dalat.note: 145km Central Highlands loop over pine-clad passes and long climbs.

hagiang.note: 150km of the Ha Giang Loop's finest passes, Ma Pi Leng included — relentless climbing.

onomichi.note: 140km island-hopping grand tour beyond the Shimanami Kaido — six islands and back.

chiangmai.note: 150km loop to the roof of Thailand and back — the region's ultimate climb day.

pokhara.note: 130km Himalayan foothills loop above Pokhara — climbing that never lets up.

ubud.note: 140km loop to the Kintamani caldera and Mt Batur — a big volcanic climbing day.

jeju.note: 150km coastal loop circling the island — the classic Jeju century.

sunmoonlake.note: 145km lake circuit reaching toward the Wuling climb — a strong-rider epic.

medellin.note: 150km on the legendary Alto de Letras flank — the world's longest paved climb.
